name: Ryan Fast
headline: Co-Founder at Switchback Advisors | NetSuite Alliance Partner | Certified NetSuite ERP Consultant

about: Accomplished accounting and finance professional focused on global enterprise resource planning, customer relationship management, analytics, automation, governance, risk and compliance.
